title: UI kit + title
goal: Every remaining UI sprite in the B01 HUD language, plus the title emblem.
notes: 9-slice rules in COMMON_CONTRACT §4 (border per asset below). Buttons: four tones (primary amber, secondary slate-blue, danger crimson, ghost transparent with an engraved outline) x four states (normal, hover = brighter rim, pressed = inset and 2 px lower, disabled = desaturated). Card frames by rarity: common iron, rare blue-silver (B01), epic violet-gold, legendary radiant gold with a crystal crown, cursed black iron with wine-red rift cracks; centre transparent or near-flat dark. `title_emblem` 1024x320: the game's emblem - the holy Crystal in a carved stone ring with wings of light, space left for a separately rendered title text (do not paint letters). `vignette`: soft dark edge vignette, black with alpha only.
